description: Let \(M\) be a finite partial matching, \(f\) an injection, and \(x\notin\operatorname{dom}M\). For any label type \(L\) and maps \(\ell_X,\ell_Y:\mathbb N\to L\), if \(M\) respects the labels and \(\ell_X(u)=\ell_Y(f(u))\) for every \(u\), then the specified \(E_f(M,x)\) respects them too.
